sentences.en: About two-thirds of the Earth's oxygen is produced by phytoplankton.
sentences.zh: 大约三分之二的地球氧气是由浮游植物产生的。

sentences.en: Around two-thirds of our body is made up of water.
sentences.zh: 我们身体的大约三分之二是由水组成的。

sentences.en: Agricultural exports, including fish, make up two-thirds of total exports.
sentences.zh: 包括鱼类在内的农业出口占总出口的三分之二。
